integrationStatus: Art review and baked atlases only; gameplay charge events are not wired yet.
registration: Five copies of the source actor with authored position, phase and reaction-delay tracks.

animations.label: Idle
animations.description: Five javelinists hold the standard two-back, three-front layout.

animations.label: Movement
animations.description: Five alternating walking cycles with small phase differences.

animations.label: Javelin volley
animations.description: Plant and throw from the standard ranks with a short stagger, then draw fresh javelins.

animations.label: Get hit
animations.description: Light hit reactions through all five members.

animations.label: Get charged
animations.description: Heavy impact hits the front three first, then the two at the back. Everyone recovers.

animations.label: Charge in
animations.description: The rear pair runs through two open lanes into the inner wedge. The front flanks arc outward, then settle as the trailing pair; the center leads.

animations.label: Maintain charge
animations.description: Keep running in the wedge until the attack or exit phase is requested.

animations.label: Charge volley
animations.description: Stop in the wedge and throw: tip first, then inner pair, then trailing pair. Rear members wait in the planted ready pose.

animations.label: Transition out
animations.description: The outer pair catches up to the front flanks while the inner pair drops back into the rear rank. Settle into the original standard formation.

animations.label: Death
animations.description: Front three fall before the rear two. Three buckle onto their side; two recoil and fall onto their back. All five stay down.

chargeSequence.reviewTravelNote: Forward travel is an inspection reference only. It scrolls the review ground; it is never baked as squad movement or applied to gameplay.

gameplayContract.note: Presentation contract only. Gameplay owns movement, target range, attack authorization and projectile events. Ranged attack is requested after the advance stops; physical contact is not required.
